stem:
Nalini's hands are wet after washing. She wants to turn off a wall switch.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: She may touch the switch with wet hands.
She should dry her hands before touching the switch.
She must not touch any switch, even later with dry hands.
She may touch the switch with wet hands if the switch looks cool and dry.

teacher.key_rationale: Wet skin raises shock risk. Dry the hands before touching the switch; dry-hand use is not itself banned.
